recentItems.title: Transportation Sec. Duffy explains what caused the nationwide FAA ground stop
recentItems.description:
U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said Saturday that a technical failure involving an aging telecommunications network and maintenance work at a remote Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) facility caused a nationwide flight disruption a day earlier.

recentItems.title: Bomb explosion in Syrian capital Damascus kills 2, including a child
recentItems.description:
An explosive device placed inside a car in a suburb of the Syrian capital exploded Saturday evening, killing two people, state TV and the Interior Ministry said. The explosion took place in the southern Damascus suburb of Jaramana near a factory where batteries are produced, according to state TV. (AP video by Abdel Rahman Shaheen, Production by Ali Sharafeddine)

recentItems.title: Students in Albania say they'll continue protesting until PM Edi Rama resigns
recentItems.description:
Students protested in the Albanian capital Tirana on Saturday in a series of anti-government demonstrations that began in early October. Protesters burned trash bins, blocked city roads and smashed windows at a bus stop. (AP video by Erion Xhabafti)

recentItems.title: NYC’s first museum dedicated to civil rights opens up in Harlem
recentItems.description: The National Urban League will open a museum this weekend in Harlem dedicated to the civil rights struggles in the North, the first of its kind in New York City. Here’s what AP’s Fabianna Rincon saw when AP got an exclusive look inside.
